name: OFAC Screening Agent
description: Heuristic pre-screen only -- matches client name/country against a hardcoded list (10 countries, 4 regex patterns compiled into source). Does NOT call any external OFAC/SDN API or watchlist. A match is real signal (status: flagged); no match does NOT mean a real sanctions screen cleared this client (status: not_authoritatively_screened). Logs result to audit trail.
